Manage req documents.

Usage: papyrus req [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]

Commands:
  create        Create a business requirement
  create-group  Create a business-requirement group
  list          List business requirements
  view          View a business requirement
  edit          Edit a business requirement
  archive       Archive a business requirement
  delete        Delete a business requirement
  status        Set business requirement status
  help          Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --json           Emit stable, machine-readable JSON.
      --dir <path>     Project directory. Default: the current working directory.
      --config <file>  Configuration file. Default: papyrus.config.yml in the project directory.
      --no-color       Disable ANSI color output.
  -h, --help           Print help
